current_priorities: Debloquer un generateur d'image de qualite pro accessible par cle API depuis GitHub Actions
Rendre les 5 cerveaux perpetuels reellement fonctionnels
Produire et publier le premier coloring book abouti (qualite vendable)
system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: HEMA (Historical European Martial Arts) Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: Adults (20-45) practicing historical fencing, obsessed with historical manuals (Fiore de' Liberi, Lichtenauer), looking for apparel and training accessories that reflect their specific weapon or school.
product_angles: Minimalist vector apparel featuring specific guards (e.g., 'Posta di Donna')
KDP Training Logs designed specifically for HEMA sparring and tournament tracking
Humorous tees playing on historical fencing insider jokes vs modern Olympic fencing
proposals.first_test_product: HEMA Sparring Logbook & Technique Tracker on Amazon KDP

proposals.name: French GR (Grande Randonnee) Hikers
proposals.buyer_persona: Outdoor enthusiasts hiking famous French trails (GR20, GR34, GR5). They love tracking their progress, collecting memorabilia, and showing off their completed trails.
product_angles: KDP Hiking Journals dedicated to one specific GR trail with elevation maps outline
Redbubble stickers and patches with the exact trail topology and landmark coordinates
Printable PDF checklists and packing lists for specific French climates
proposals.first_test_product: GR34 (Sentier des Douaniers) Personal Hiking Journal & Logbook on KDP

proposals.name: Solo Board Gamers (Print & Play / PnP)
proposals.buyer_persona: Gamers who play board games alone, frequently downloading Print & Play files, looking for high-quality, low-cost asset upgrades (tokens, campaign trackers, modular card decks).
product_angles: Modular 3D-printable tokens and card holders on Cults3D
Printable PDF campaign logs and custom score sheets
Aesthetic minimalist custom deck of generic solo-gaming AI enemy triggers
proposals.first_test_product: Universal Solo Board Game Campaign Tracker & Logbook on KDP

proposals.name: Solarpunk Aesthetic Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Eco-conscious tech-optimists who love the fusion of green nature, stained glass, art nouveau, and futuristic clean energy. They dislike cyberpunk dystopia and crave beautiful positive imagery.
product_angles: Intricate Solarpunk architecture coloring books on KDP
Solarpunk stained-glass window design stickers on Redbubble
Digital wallpaper packs for vertical mobile screens (Etsy/Gumroad)
proposals.first_test_product: Solarpunk Cities: An Eco-Futurist Stained Glass Coloring Book on KDP

proposals.name: Retro PSX / Low-Poly Horror Gamedevs
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers on itch.io and Unity/Unreal marketplaces building retro survival horror games inspired by Resident Evil 1, Silent Hill, and modern retro publishers like DreadXP.
product_angles: Low-poly 3D models of 90s household items and medical supplies on Cults3D/Itch
Dithered PSX-style UI/UX button and icon packs (PNG/SVG formats)
Retro texture seamless packs (grunge concrete, old wood, CRT monitor effect overlays)
proposals.first_test_product: PSX Retro Horror UI & Icon Asset Pack (PNG/SVG) on Itch/Etsy

proposals.name: Compagnons du Devoir & French Artisans
proposals.buyer_persona: Highly skilled French apprentices and master artisans (carpenters, stone masons, roofers, bakers) who have a deep pride in their manual brotherhood, traditional tools, and regional masterworks.
product_angles: Highly accurate vector graphic designs of historical tools (e.g., L'Équerre et le Compas) on apparel
Workplace-safe custom sticker packs for toolboxes
Notebooks with technical isometric grids specifically designed for wood/stone sketching
proposals.first_test_product: Carnet de Croquis de Menuiserie / Charpente (Isometric Grid Notebook) on KDP
